section_1.title: Studying with kids? This helps.
section_1.description: Covers up to 85% of registered childcare while you study — paid termly, and it doesn't reduce your maintenance loan.

section_2.title: How it works & key rules
section_2.description: The grant is paid directly into the Childcare Grant Payment Service (CCGPS) to pay your provider.

cards.title: Paid termly
cards.description: SFE pays the grant in three installments throughout the academic year.

cards.title: Registered providers
cards.description: Your nursery, childminder or school club must be fully Ofsted registered.

cards.title: Full-time study
cards.description: Available only to undergraduate students on full-time designated courses.

faqs.q: Do I have to pay back the Childcare Grant?
faqs.a: No, the Childcare Grant is a grant, not a loan, and does not need to be repaid unless you leave your course early.

faqs.q: Can I get it if my partner works?
faqs.a: Yes, but it is income-assessed based on your overall household income.
